source.ref: IPC-2152 section 5 (plane-adjacent modifier applied to the still-air chart family); derivation: dT_2152 = dT_2221 / 1.3^(1/0.44), the commonly cited ~1.3x plane-adjacent current-capacity modifier expressed as a dT ratio; the (0.0884 mm^2, 4.68 A) point is the classic 100 mil / 1 oz / 10 C IPC-2221 example

notes: AM-04 Ruling 7(b) conservatism reference SET (one dataset, one entry -- four points would shadow each other under the duplicate-(kind,scope) rule). VALUES ARE MODIFIER-DERIVED, not chart-transcribed: the 2221 figures are the solver's own closed form; the 2152 plane-adjacent figures derive from the published plane modifier. OWNER VERIFY against the standard before promotion -- chart-transcribed values supersede this derivation as a revision. The conservatism claim under test: our 4-layer boards are plane-adjacent, so the 2221 solver over-predicts heating (conservative) on this class. The 2152 still-air NO-PLANE chart is MORE conservative than 2221 in parts of its domain -- that comparison deliberately carries no direction assertion. At calibration (CL-13 label, per family+quantity) these same points tighten into accuracy assertions within an owner-set tolerance band (Ruling 7 latch).
